data.name: Chart_Loading
data.comment: Placeholder drawn on a chart while its data is on the way.

data.name: Chart_PickSource
data.comment: Placeholder drawn on a chart that has no data variable yet.

data.name: Empty_Hint
data.value: Inputs write kernel variables. Charts plot a data source. Switch to Preview to use the app.
data.comment: Smaller text under Empty_Title. 'Preview' matches Toolbar_Preview.

data.name: Empty_Title
data.value: Drag a widget from the left onto the canvas.
data.comment: Text in the middle of an empty canvas.

data.name: Layout_Description
data.value: Isolated layout that turns a notebook into a live, parameterized app built from draggable widgets and charts.
data.comment: Second line of the sample's entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Layout_DisplayName
data.comment: Label in the layout picker. Stays as written.

data.name: Layout_Name
data.comment: Name of the sample extension as listed in the Extensions panel. 'Form Studio' is the sample's name and stays as written; 'Layout' translates.

data.name: Palette_Bar
data.comment: Palette entry for a bar chart, and the word used in Widget_ChartLabel.

data.name: Palette_Charts
data.comment: Heading of the second group in the widget palette.

data.name: Palette_Drag_Tip
data.comment: Tooltip on every palette entry.

data.name: Palette_Dropdown
data.comment: Palette entry and default label of that widget.

data.name: Palette_Inputs
data.comment: Heading of the first group in the widget palette.

data.name: Palette_Label
data.comment: Palette entry for a static text widget.

data.name: Palette_Line
data.comment: Palette entry for a line chart, and the word used in Widget_ChartLabel.

data.name: Palette_Number
data.comment: Palette entry and default label of that widget: a numeric input.

data.name: Palette_Pie
data.comment: Palette entry for a pie chart, and the word used in Widget_ChartLabel.

data.name: Palette_Scatter
data.comment: Palette entry for a scatter chart, and the word used in Widget_ChartLabel.

data.name: Palette_Slider
data.comment: Palette entry and default label of that widget.

data.name: Palette_Text
data.comment: Palette entry and default label of that widget: a text input.

data.name: Palette_Toggle
data.comment: Palette entry and default label of that widget: an on/off switch.

data.name: Props_BindsTo
data.comment: Field: the kernel variable an input writes.

data.name: Props_BindsTo_Hint
data.value: The kernel variable this input writes.
data.comment: Help text under the Binds to variable field.

data.name: Props_ChartType
data.comment: Field: bar, line, pie, or scatter.

data.name: Props_Data
data.comment: Field: the variable a chart plots.

data.name: Props_Data_Hint
data.value: The kernel variable to plot (a DataBlock or DataTable).
data.comment: Help text under the Data field. DataBlock and DataTable are type names and stay as written.

data.name: Props_Delete
data.comment: Button at the bottom of the properties column.

data.name: Props_Label
data.comment: Field: the text shown above a widget.

data.name: Props_Max
data.comment: Field: a slider's largest value.

data.name: Props_Min
data.comment: Field: a slider's smallest value.

data.name: Props_None
data.value: Select a widget to edit its settings, or drag a new one from the palette.
data.comment: Properties column text when nothing is selected.

data.name: Props_Options
data.comment: Field: the choices a dropdown offers, typed as one line.

data.name: Props_SeriesColor
data.comment: Field: the color of the plotted series.

data.name: Props_Step
data.comment: Field: a slider's increment.

data.name: Props_Text
data.comment: Field: the content of a static text widget.

data.name: Props_Title
data.comment: Heading of the properties column on the right.

data.name: Props_XAxis
data.comment: Field: the column along the bottom of a chart.

data.name: Props_YAxis
data.comment: Field: the columns plotted as series.

data.name: Seed_MinimumUnits
data.comment: Label of the slider in the starter dashboard a fresh notebook opens with.

data.name: Seed_Region
data.comment: Label of the dropdown in the starter dashboard. Its choices are data values the notebook's code compares and stay in English.

data.name: Seed_RevenueByMonth
data.comment: Title of the line chart in the starter dashboard.

data.name: Seed_UnitsByMonth
data.comment: Title of the bar chart in the starter dashboard.

data.name: Select_None
data.comment: Only entry of a dropdown that has nothing to offer.

data.name: Select_PickSourceFirst
data.comment: Shown in place of the series checkboxes until a chart has data.

data.name: Toolbar_AutoRun
data.comment: Checkbox label in the top bar.

data.name: Toolbar_AutoRun_Tip
data.value: Re-run the notebook automatically when an input changes
data.comment: Tooltip on the Auto-run checkbox.

data.name: Toolbar_Edit
data.comment: Left half of the mode switch: arrange widgets.

data.name: Toolbar_Export
data.comment: Top bar button that downloads the dashboard definition.

data.name: Toolbar_Export_Tip
data.comment: Tooltip on the Export button. JSON is a format name and stays as written.

data.name: Toolbar_Preview
data.comment: Right half of the mode switch: use the dashboard.

data.name: Toolbar_Run
data.comment: Top bar button that re-runs the notebook.

data.name: Toolbar_Run_Tip
data.comment: Tooltip on the Run button.

data.name: Widget_ChartLabel
data.comment: Default title of a newly added chart. {0} is the chart kind, such as Palette_Bar.

data.name: Widget_Heading
data.comment: Default text of a newly added static text widget.

data.name: Widget_Resize_Tip
data.comment: Tooltip on the resize handle in a widget's corner.
